notes: Ask for "two and a half minutes" and you get two and a half minutes — it was being read as thirty seconds. "a minute" and "an hour" work as lengths now too. When a request runs into a limit Crisp says so up front: speeding a long clip to a short target now shows the length it will actually reach, and a GIF says it caps at 30 seconds instead of promising 60. "Make it look 80s" gets the vintage look instead of doing nothing.
